text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To let Neo Universe rest since she wasn't feeling well,
I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The "requirement" is 'early recovery'...
So, engage in 'rest', huh?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Is this... 'MABTE', outer space...?

text_block_list.name: Club President?
text_block_list.text:
""ProjectXXX" Investigator 001,
Individual Designation: Neo Universe—
Delivering progress report on Earth civilization "observation"."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
(Report... "Recall"—
This was a "periodic report," right?)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――"UNDY."
"Observed" a useful "Plant." Name――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Soybeans."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Attribute: "Edible"... Contains high-quality protein.
"THRF"—
"Applicable" to all organic life forms.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
And this is titled "Japanese Set Meal." Contents:
miso soup, natto, tofu, soy sauce-simmered mackerel—

text_block_list.name: Club President?
text_block_list.text: Ho...? From what I can see, this appears to be ordinary commoner food for Earthlings...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I shall report... the most crucial matter of this investigation.
—Every single one of these is connected to 'soybeans.'"

text_block_list.name: Club President?
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What... did you say...!?
The shape, the taste—everything is completely different!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: It's practically a "Big Bang" at this point.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"‘Natto’... uses a paranormal technology known as ‘fermentation’.
‘Soy sauce’ uses a ‘light-year-scale’ method known as ‘brewing’.
And the ‘shocking’ truth—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Onto the "natto"... "drip" the "soy sauce"—!

text_block_list.name: Club President?
text_block_list.text: Putting "soybeans" on top of "soybeans"... WHAAAAT!?

text_block_list.name: Club President?
text_block_list.text:
W-What an accomplishment... Investigator 001,
your investigative skills are top-notch. Keep up the good work...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Dream"... "EITOR"――
Maybe it's an "unconscious" mission...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Continued "observation" is necessary, yes.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...For this afternoon, 'soybeans' sound good.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Attribute: "Edible"... Contains high-quality protein.
"THRF"—
"Applicable" to all organic life forms.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “—First, 'natto.' It is produced through 'fermentation' using 'natto bacteria'—”

text_block_list.name: Club President?
text_block_list.text: !? W-What is this overpowering smell...!?

text_block_list.name: Club President?
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you let it rot!? Unbelievable!
It would've been better to just eat the bowl!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"CUTT"—"Natto" has high "functionality."
Above all, it's "delicious," and yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having had bad dreams,
Neo Universe was unable to get back in form.
